verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows React offering AI-driven generation of component-level tests from declared props or state. The llms.txt file, TypeScript prop typing, and DevTools for inspecting props and state are adjacent building blocks, not test generation. The axis is fair for a UI framework's ecosystem, so absence of evidence yields "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an ai-native developer, I can have AI generate component-level tests based on the props and reactive state my component declares
